quests.title: Food Matters

dialogue.t: Ugh... I should have brought more Lakkaberries...

dialogue.sit: (It seems they were handing out food...)

dialogue.t: Hello, {NICKNAME}, are you here for a Feast of the Moon? I'm so sorry, but... you might have to wait a little while.

dialogue.sit: What is a Feast of the Moon?

dialogue.t: Huh? Didn't you get one last time...? Oh, right, Lady Lauma organized that one... and I guess she didn't mention the meal's official name.
Simply put, a Feast of the Moon is a free meal we Frostmoon Scions distribute to those in need.
Helping such people has ever been one of our traditions, though it used to be limited to the area around Hiisi Island...
But under Lady Lauma's leadership and with everyone's help, we've gradually expanded our reach.
Lady Lauma says this is part of spreading the Moon Goddess's Favor to all. There's a saying that goes... Um...
"The first fruit of the harvest must be placed upon the Moonlight Altar — not as an offering to the gods, but as a spark for..."
"A spark for..." Umm... What was the rest of it again...
*Ahem*, anyway! This shop is one of the main distribution points for the meal. Hehe, and I manage almost everything here by myself! Pretty impressive, right?
We've had a lot of trouble getting the meals out in Nasha Town, but I believe in what Lady Lauma says — we really can help more people this way!

However... when I was preparing the ingredients yesterday, I forgot to close the box lid tightly, and when I woke up this morning, many fruits had been pecked open by birds and were completely unusable.
I can barely make any Feasts of the Moon with the remaining Lakkaberries... *sigh*... What should I do now...

dialogue.sit: I'll go gather some for you.

dialogue.t: You... you want to help?! Thank you so much! Really, thank you! Then... please bring me five <color=#00E1FFFF>Lakkaberries</color>, that should be just enough!
Once you bring them back, I promise I'll make you the tastiest Feast of the Moon you've ever had!
Oh, you're back! Did you get the Lakkaberries?
These will be enough. Thank you, thank you so much! Just a moment — I'll prepare the most delicious Feast of the Moon you've ever seen!

dialogue.sit: Lyylikki rushes to the kitchen and throws herself into preparing the Feast of the Moon...

dialogue.t: It's ready. Please, have a taste.
Thank you again for your help. Should you get hungry next time, please feel free to come by. I'll prepare a special portion just for you.
